mapper.select: SELECT c.id,c.snapshot_id,c.file_path,c.symbol_name,c.symbol_kind,c.start_line,c.end_line,c.content,c.content_hash, (CASE WHEN POSITION(LOWER(#{query}) IN LOWER(c.file_path))>0 THEN .35 ELSE 0 END +CASE WHEN POSITION(LOWER(#{query}) IN LOWER(COALESCE(c.symbol_name,'')))>0 THEN .4 ELSE 0 END +CASE WHEN POSITION(LOWER(#{query}) IN LOWER(c.content))>0 THEN .25 ELSE 0 END +(1-(e.embedding <=> CAST(#{vector} AS vector)))*.55) score FROM code_chunks c JOIN chunk_embeddings e ON e.chunk_id=c.id WHERE c.repo_id=#{repositoryId} ORDER BY score DESC,c.file_path,c.start_line NULLS FIRST LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.id,c.title,c.card_type,c.content,c.revision,e.content_hash, (CASE WHEN POSITION(LOWER(#{query}) IN LOWER(c.title))>0 THEN .55 ELSE 0 END +CASE WHEN POSITION(LOWER(#{query}) IN LOWER(c.content))>0 THEN .3 ELSE 0 END +CASE WHEN POSITION(LOWER(#{query}) IN LOWER(ARRAY_TO_STRING(c.tags,' ')))>0 THEN .25 ELSE 0 END +(1-(e.embedding <=> CAST(#{vector} AS vector)))*.55) score FROM knowledge_cards c JOIN knowledge_card_embeddings e ON e.card_id=c.id AND e.revision=c.revision WHERE c.repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND c.status='PUBLISHED' ORDER BY score DESC,c.updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT source_symbol,target_symbol,relation FROM code_graph_edges WHERE repo_id=#{repositoryId} LIMIT 500
SELECT id,snapshot_id,symbol_name,content FROM code_chunks WHERE repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND symbol_name IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO code_graph_edges(id,repo_id,snapshot_id,source_chunk_id,target_chunk_id,source_symbol,target_symbol,relation) VALUES(#{id},#{repositoryId},#{snapshotId},#{sourceChunkId},#{targetChunkId},#{sourceSymbol},#{targetSymbol},'CALLS') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id,repo_id,title,card_type,content,tags,status,revision,created_at,updated_at, verified_commit,code_review_status,code_reviewed_at FROM knowledge_cards WHERE repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND status='PUBLISHED' ORDER BY updated_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_cards SET title=#{title},card_type=#{cardType},content=#{content}, tags=#{tags,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler},status=#{status}, revision=revision+1,updated_by=#{actorId},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND repo_id=#{repositoryId}
mapper.select: SELECT id,snapshot_id,file_path,symbol_name,start_line,end_line,content,content_hash FROM code_chunks WHERE repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND id=#{chunkId}

SELECT r.chunk_id,r.snapshot_id,r.file_path,r.symbol_name,r.start_line,r.end_line,r.content_hash, (c.id IS NULL) stale FROM knowledge_code_refs r LEFT JOIN code_chunks c ON c.id=r.chunk_id AND c.content_hash=r.content_hash WHERE r.repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND r.card_id=#{cardId} AND r.revision=#{revision} ORDER BY r.position
SELECT setting_key,CASE WHEN sensitive THEN '******' ELSE setting_value END value FROM system_settings ORDER BY setting_key
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO system_settings(setting_key,setting_value,updated_by) VALUES(#{key},#{value},#{actorId}) ON CONFLICT(setting_key) DO UPDATE SET setting_value=EXCLUDED.setting_value,updated_by=EXCLUDED.updated_by,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT c.id,c.revision,CONCAT(c.title,E'\n',c.content,E'\n',ARRAY_TO_STRING(c.tags,' ')) content FROM knowledge_cards c LEFT JOIN knowledge_card_embeddings e ON e.card_id=c.id WHERE c.repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND c.status='PUBLISHED' AND(e.card_id IS NULL OR e.revision<>c.revision OR e.model<>#{model})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_card_embeddings(card_id,repo_id,revision,model,embedding,content_hash) VALUES(#{cardId},#{repositoryId},#{revision},#{model},CAST(#{vector} AS vector),#{contentHash}) ON CONFLICT(card_id) DO UPDATE SET revision=EXCLUDED.revision,embedding=EXCLUDED.embedding, model=EXCLUDED.model,content_hash=EXCLUDED.content_hash,created_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

INSERT INTO chunk_embeddings(chunk_id,repo_id,model,dimension,embedding,content_hash) VALUES(#{chunkId},#{repositoryId},#{model},64,CAST(#{vector} AS vector),#{contentHash}) ON CONFLICT(chunk_id) DO UPDATE SET model=EXCLUDED.model,embedding=EXCLUDED.embedding, content_hash=EXCLUDED.content_hash,created_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
